transcript.text: Good morning, Riverside Medical Clinic. This is the automated booking assistant. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'd like to book an appointment with Dr Mitchell please.
Of course! Can I get your full name please?
Emily Thornton.
Thank you Emily. Can I confirm your date of birth?
15th of March, 1985.
Great. What is the reason for your visit today?
I've been having some chest tightness and wanted to get it checked out.
Understood. I can see Dr Mitchell has availability tomorrow morning at 9 AM. Does that work for you?
Yes, that's perfect.
Wonderful! I've booked you in with Dr Mitchell on the 27th of May at 9 AM. You'll receive a confirmation SMS shortly. Is there anything else I can help with?
No that's great, thank you.
You're welcome Emily. See you then. Goodbye!
Good morning, Riverside Medical Clinic. How can I help?
Yeah g'day, I need to see a GP pretty urgently. Got a bad ear infection I think.
I'm sorry to hear that. Let me check what's available today. Could I get your name please?
Marcus Webb.
Thanks Marcus. Dr Chen has a slot available this morning at 8 AM. It's a bit early — would that work?
Yeah that's fine, I'll take it.
Perfect. You're booked with Dr Chen at 8 AM today. Please arrive 5 minutes early. Anything else?
No, cheers.
Take care Marcus. Goodbye!
Good afternoon, Riverside Medical Clinic. How can I assist you?
Hello, I'd like to book my daughter in to see Dr Sharma please.
Of course! I can help with that. Could I get your daughter's full name and date of birth?
Her name is Zara Patel and she was born on the 3rd of June 2018.
Thank you. And what's the reason for the appointment?
She's had a fever for two days and I'm a bit worried.
I understand. Dr Sharma has availability tomorrow morning at 9 AM. Would that suit you?
Yes, tomorrow at 9 works perfectly.
Wonderful. I've booked Zara in with Dr Sharma on the 28th of May at 9 AM. You'll get a confirmation message. Is there anything else?
No, that's all thank you.
Take care! Goodbye.
Good afternoon, Riverside Medical Clinic. How can I help?
What are your opening hours?
We are open Monday to Friday 8 AM to 6 PM, and Saturday 9 AM to 1 PM.
Alright, thanks.
You're welcome! Is there anything else I can help you with?
No that's all.
Have a great day! Goodbye.
